 According to live feed updates, Gullu and Yung DSA reportedly got into a physical altercation during a captaincy task after Gullu allegedly pushed Yung
 Rasti Amena Follow on Twitter |   Published: 28th October 2026 1:28 pm IST Bigg Boss 20 contestant Gullu (Image source: X) Mumbai : Bigg Boss has always maintained that physical violence has no place inside the house, with contestants facing strict consequences for crossing this line. However, the ongoing season of Bigg Boss 20 appears to be witnessing another major physical altercation, just days after a similar incident involving Gullu and wildcard contestant Nakul Dhull.
 According to live feed updates, Gullu and Yung DSA reportedly got into a physical altercation during a captaincy task after Gullu allegedly pushed Yung. The incident has since triggered discussions among viewers, with fans demanding that the makers take action against Gullu.
 Gullu and Yung DSA’s fight sparks controversy
 The reported altercation took place during the captaincy task, with tensions between the two contestants escalating into a physical confrontation. Following the task, Yung DSA was reportedly upset with the other housemates for not taking a stand against Gullu.
 Yung questioned why the contestants had united against Nakul Dhull after his earlier altercation with Gullu but were not extending the same support to him. He also reportedly expressed disappointment with fellow contestant ScoutOP and demanded action against Gullu over the incident.
 The confrontation is expected to be shown in the upcoming episode, giving viewers a closer look at what transpired between the two contestants.
 View this post on Instagram This is not the first time Gullu has been involved in a physical altercation inside the Bigg Boss 20 house. A few days ago, he was involved in a major clash with wildcard contestant Nakul Dhull, following which Nakul was evicted from the show with immediate effect.
 The latest incident has now raised questions about whether the makers will take similar action against Gullu. As per the live feed updates available so far, no official announcement regarding Gullu’s eviction or disciplinary action has been made.
 However, the absence of an immediate announcement has fuelled speculation among viewers about how the makers will handle the situation. 
 Bigg Boss 20 fans demand action against Gullu
 The reported fight has sparked reactions on social media, with several viewers demanding equal treatment for all contestants. Some fans have questioned whether the same rules will apply to Gullu following the action taken against Nakul.
 Physical violence cannot be brushed aside; strict action against Gullu is necessary.. No real contribution to the show, just chaos, food..stealing and Hawabazi. His insecurity around Yung is so evident that he keeps targeting him to stay relevant #YungDSA #BB20 
— Janvi 💟 (@janvi2004f) October 27, 2026 Unfair biggboss20. Evict gullu right now!!
— thegirlnextdoor07 (@thegirlnd07) October 27, 2026 #BiggBoss MUST take action. If the makers stay silent, the audience will see the clear BIAS. Fair treatment for everyone. #BiggBoss20 #BB20 
— Nishita Sharma (@nishiparli1234) October 27, 2026 Viewers have argued that if physical violence leads to disciplinary action against one contestant, the makers should apply the same standards to everyone involved in similar incidents. Some have also warned that failing to act could fuel perceptions of favouritism inside the house.
 Whether the makers will take action against Gullu or allow him to continue his journey remains to be seen.
